caveats: Historical diagnostics are post-selection because E021-E027 already used this dataset to choose the feature policy.

spec.question: Can a T2-only LeadQuality release candidate, stripped of drift-sensitive clocks and non-robust feature families, retain useful signal and be frozen for genuinely prospective validation?
spec.hypothesis: A T2 Random Forest using the canonical corrected 30-day target and a drift-sanitized feature policy will retain directional historical discrimination without relying on calendar/progress clocks; production eligibility still requires a post-freeze cohort.
spec.primary_change: Build and freeze a T2-only LeadQuality candidate with corrected ambiguous-event target semantics and a sanitized feature policy; T0/T1 remain neutral.
secondary_changes: Remove all Availability fields from LeadQuality; InventoryServiceable remains a separate deterministic policy component.
Remove score_weekday, score_hour, score_month, days_from_lead_creation, inquiry_number, days_since_first_inquiry and prior_searches.
Keep outliers and price totals because their removal was not robustly established.
Run rolling historical diagnostics only as post-selection evidence, never as the prospective launch gate.
Freeze preprocessor, T2 RF, Platt calibrator, feature schema and manifest before future validation.

scoring_time.timestamp_definition: Second-and-later inquiry_at while no scheduled_visit with known event time has already occurred; T0/T1 remain LeadQuality-neutral.

target.censoring: right-censor immature rows; exclude AMBIGUOUS_UNKNOWN_EVENT_TIME instead of coercing it to 0

population.eligibility: T2 snapshots labeled POSITIVE or NEGATIVE by the E028 canonical target contract with a complete 30-day observation window.
exclusions: Current/future broker-response information from model inputs.

validation.strategy: post-selection historical rolling diagnostics plus frozen prospective post-freeze gate
validation.split_description: Historical data are used only for sanity diagnostics and artifact fitting because E021-E027 already informed feature selection. The confirmatory gate is the first post-freeze cohort: first eligible T2 per lead, 8 complete weeks extended by whole weeks until >=500 matured leads or 16 weeks, with no outcome peeking.

items.information_available_at: future event is label-only; model features remain as-of score_time
items.evidence: Known scheduled_visit event time is used only for y. Unknown-time scheduled_visit that could touch the window is excluded as AMBIGUOUS, never used as feature or negative.

items.source: leads + current inquiry + static spot attributes + strictly prior interaction aggregates
items.information_available_at: all retained features are observable at or before score_time
items.evidence: Calendar/progress clocks, prior_searches, Availability, broker prior, lead_score_internal and current-state Spot aggregates are excluded.
Availability is handled separately by E028 InventoryServiceable and cannot create predictive lift inside E029 LeadQuality.

items.source: future production cohort after artifact freeze
items.information_available_at: outcomes are inspected only after the fixed gate cohort matures
